summary: Admicom Oyj provides software solutions and support services in Finland and internationally. The company offers enterprise resource planning solutions, including project financials, production and site management, and payroll and accounting; project management solutions, such as project lifecycle management, project control and planning, and site quality and safety; and business services comprising statutory accounting and payroll services, as well as additional financial management expert services. It also provides documentation; accounting; training and consulting; customer support; implementation; and service contracts. The company serves construction, building services engineering, and real estate sectors. Admicom Oyj was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Jyväskylä, Finland.
